module vdu_ram_2k_attr (
    input         clk,
    input         rst,
    input         we,
    input  [10:0] addr,
    output [ 7:0] rdata,
    input  [ 7:0] wdata
  );

  // Registers and nets
  reg [ 7:0] mem[0:2047];
  reg [10:0] addr_reg;

  always @(posedge clk)
    begin
      if (we) mem[addr] <= wdata;
      addr_reg <= addr;
    end

  // Combinatorial logic
  assign rdata = mem[addr_reg];

  initial $readmemh("attr_rom.dat", mem);

endmodule
